Thermal Shock Chamber - TSB series
Product catalog summary
Introduction
The document introduces ESPEC's next-generation liquid-to-liquid thermal shock chambers, TSB-21 and TSB-51, designed to enhance reliability in electronics by imposing higher thermal stress than air-to-air testing. These chambers are environmentally friendly and cost-effective, addressing traditional challenges of brine and power consumption.
Utility and Features
The chambers significantly reduce brine consumption by 65% through enhanced airtightness and recycling mechanisms. They support both single-liquid and double-liquid brine, with models accommodating specimens up to 2.0 kg. An air cylinder system ensures smooth specimen transfer, and recorder terminals are standard for temperature monitoring.
Energy Efficiency
Energy savings of up to 52% are achieved with a new refrigeration circuit. Noise levels are reduced to 65 dB through soundproofing. Optional paperless recording and remote control via PC are available.
Control and Display
The chambers feature a color LCD touch-panel system for easy operation, displaying test patterns, temperatures, and cycle information. The system supports interactive input and detailed test monitoring.
Specifications
The TSB-21 and TSB-51 models operate with a two-liquid bath system, supporting a wide temperature range and rapid temperature changes. They are equipped with various safety devices and auxiliary functions to ensure reliable operation.
Test Standards
The chambers comply with MIL-STD-883E and MIL-STD-202G standards, supporting various test conditions and cycles.
Safety and Caution
Users are cautioned against using explosive or inflammable specimens and advised to use the correct brine to avoid reducing the chamber's service life.
Options and Accessories
Optional features include specimen baskets, casters for mobility, built-in air compressors, and various temperature recording and communication options.
Contact Information
The document provides contact details for ESPEC's global offices and highlights their ISO 9001:2008 certification.
